validation_method.sample_rounding: llama-bench prints samples_ts with %g: six significant digits.
validation_method.mean_rate: mean(unrounded sample rates), compared to avg_ts rounded to six decimal places.
validation_method.summary_parity: Exact equality of raw avg_ts and corresponding saved source-row metric.

offload_evidence.source_reported_context: One direct greedy 256-token prompt; three interleaved repetitions per setting, cold store each start. Exact input IDs and individual logs not attached.

component_diagnostics.method: 260.7 / drive_test_mb_s * 1000. PCIe4 uses low endpoint of reported 7100-7212 range. Idealized component diagnostic only, not an end-to-end prediction or proven bandwidth bound.
